items.stem: What does the news report say about Nancy Gifford?

choices.text: She was born months after the end of World War I.
choices.zh: 她出生于第一次世界大战结束几个月后。

choices.text: She has been living in her house throughout her life.
choices.zh: 她一生都住在自己的房子里。

choices.text: She suffered a great deal during the Second World War.
choices.zh: 第二次世界大战期间，她遭受了巨大的痛苦。

choices.text: She is a 102-year-old woman living in Somerset Village.
choices.zh: 她是一名居住在萨默塞特村的102岁女性。

items.stem: Why is Mrs. Gifford selling the house?

choices.text: She has been persuaded by the estate agent.
choices.zh: 她被房地产经纪人说服了。

choices.text: She needs the money badly for her health.
choices.zh: 她因健康问题急需这笔钱。

choices.text: She is leaving Glastonbury Village.
choices.zh: 她要离开格拉斯顿伯里村。

choices.text: She is moving to a nursing home.

items.stem: What does the news report say was key to the man's rescue?

choices.text: The navy's timely arrival.
His rich sailing experience.
The word HELP written on the boat.
His use of a mirror to send a signal.

items.stem: What do we learn about the man when he was rescued?

choices.text: He lost all consciousness.
He was in good condition.
He was too distressed to pick himself up.
choices.zh: 他因过度悲痛而无法站起身来。

choices.text: He entirely abandoned himself to despair.

items.stem: What do we learn about the elementary and middle schools to be closed in Denver?

choices.text: Their efforts to provide social services have been ignored.
choices.zh: 它们为提供社会服务所作的努力一直被忽视。

choices.text: They have been criticized by the Denver school board.
choices.zh: 它们一直受到丹佛教育委员会的批评。

choices.text: They have taken various steps to get more funding.
choices.zh: 它们采取了各种措施来获得更多资金。

choices.text: Their enrollment has been on a noticeable decline.
choices.zh: 它们的入学人数一直在明显减少。

items.stem: What does the Denver district expect to do in the next three years?

choices.text: Approve criteria for closing schools with decreased funding.
choices.zh: 批准在资金减少的情况下关闭学校的标准。

choices.text: Enroll 3,000 fewer elementary and middle school students.
choices.zh: 小学和初中的入学人数减少三千名。

choices.text: Decide which elementary and middle schools to close.
choices.zh: 决定关闭哪些小学和初中。

choices.text: Alter its per-pupil funding policy on a rational basis.
choices.zh: 根据合理原则调整其按学生人数拨款的政策。

items.stem: Why are some schools in Denver to be closed according to the district spokesperson?

choices.text: To enable the district to remain competitive.
choices.zh: 使该学区能够保持竞争力。

choices.text: To avoid a negative impact on its economy.
choices.zh: 避免对其经济造成负面影响。

choices.text: To keep the district free of debt.
To obtain the expected funding.

items.stem: Why does the woman call the man?

choices.text: To book tickets for a musical.
To enquire about the price of cats.
To pay for her afternoon flight to London.
choices.zh: 支付她下午飞往伦敦的航班费用。

choices.text: To have her personal computer repaired.

items.stem: What do we learn about the woman's husband?

choices.text: He frequents the Lion Theatre.
He knows how to sell things well.
choices.zh: 他知道如何很好地销售东西。

choices.text: He is a computer science expert.
He is away on a business trip.

items.stem: What does the man say about the tickets at the front?

choices.text: They are sold at a discount.
They are in low demand.
They are no longer available.
They are not too expensive.

items.stem: What does the woman say she is scared of?

choices.text: Heights.
Circus.
Wild animals.
Dark nights.

items.stem: Why hasn't the man answered the woman's text messages lately?

choices.text: He finds it bothersome to reply.
choices.zh: 他觉得回复短信很麻烦。

choices.text: He has switched off his phone.
He hasn't got the time to text back.
He doesn't know how to respond.

items.stem: What was the man shocked to realize after he downloaded the APP?

choices.text: His lack of sufficient sleep at night.
His addiction to mobile phone games.
His excessive use of the mobile phone.
His high frequency of surfing the net.

items.stem: What did the man spend much time doing with his phone?

choices.text: Shopping online and paying for his purchases.
choices.zh: 网上购物并为所购商品付款。

choices.text: Communicating with friends on social media.
choices.zh: 在社交媒体上与朋友交流。

choices.text: Exploring whatever content to his liking.
choices.zh: 浏览自己喜欢的各种内容。

choices.text: Sharing and posting pictures and videos.
choices.zh: 分享和发布图片及视频。

items.stem: Why does the woman say she has to use her mobile phone?

choices.text: She prefers chatting with others online to meeting them.
choices.zh: 比起与他人见面，她更喜欢在网上与他人聊天。

choices.text: There are few physical stores near where she lives.
choices.zh: 她居住地附近几乎没有实体店。

choices.text: Ordering meals online is a great convenience to her.
choices.zh: 网上订餐给她带来了极大的便利。

choices.text: She needs to talk with her friends and family far away.
choices.zh: 她需要和远方的朋友及家人交谈。

items.stem: What does the passage say about the gap in wage gains between job switchers and those who stay in their jobs?

choices.text: It is now narrowing.
It keeps increasing.
It has remained huge.
It will soon disappear.

items.stem: What do we learn about wage growth now?

choices.text: It is fluctuating between 5-7%.
It is slowing down for everyone.
choices.zh: 对所有人来说都在放缓。

choices.text: It is faster for those who stay in their jobs.
choices.zh: 留在原岗位的人工资增长更快。

choices.text: It is inadequate for dealing with inflation.

items.stem: What is the labor market likely doing according to the passage?

choices.text: Booming.
Stabilizing.
Struggling.
Cooling.

items.stem: What does a new study show about highly processed foods?

choices.text: They have smaller amounts of nutrients than unprocessed diets.
choices.zh: 与未加工饮食相比，其中的营养成分含量更低。

choices.text: Their contribution to calorie consumption is hard to determine.
choices.zh: 它们对热量摄入的贡献难以确定。

choices.text: They account for nearly half of the average American diet.
choices.zh: 它们约占美国人平均饮食的一半。

choices.text: Their low price and convenience negatively impact health.
choices.zh: 它们价格低廉且方便，这对健康有负面影响。

items.stem: What are highly processed foods linked to, according to other research?

choices.text: A strong desire to overeat.
A lack of nutrients like fiber.
A higher risk of cancer and obesity.
choices.zh: 较高的癌症和肥胖风险。

choices.text: A greater intake of sugar and salt.

items.stem: What do people tend to do when eating highly processed foods?

choices.text: Eat more quickly.
Feel full sooner.
Chew thoroughly.
Swallow bit by bit.

items.stem: How do people generally account for differences between men and women in the amount of time spent on housework?

choices.text: By attributing them to current cultural influences.
choices.zh: 将其归因于当今的文化影响。

choices.text: By attributing them to conservative thinking.
In terms of new genetic findings.
choices.zh: 从新的遗传学发现的角度解释。

choices.text: In terms of personal preferences.
choices.zh: 从个人偏好的角度解释。

items.stem: What did men lean toward doing according to the new study?

choices.text: Sharing with women the chores they see necessary.
choices.zh: 与女性分担他们认为必要的家务。

choices.text: Dividing housework that is demanding for women.
choices.zh: 分担对女性来说要求较高的家务。

choices.text: Performing household tasks that they enjoy.
Doing tasks that are physically challenging.
choices.zh: 做体力上具有挑战性的家务。

items.stem: What should we keep in mind as regards any research on group differences?

choices.text: The large within-group differences.
choices.zh: 群体内部存在的巨大差异。

choices.text: The great similarities across groups.
choices.zh: 不同群体之间存在的巨大相似性。

choices.text: The researchers' subjective biases.
The noticeable overgeneralizations.

items.stem: What did previous research reveal about gender differences in attitudes toward family and career?

choices.text: They seem to be universal.
choices.zh: 这种差异似乎是普遍存在的。

choices.text: They impact people's whole life.
choices.zh: 这种差异影响人们的一生。

choices.text: They shape one's role in society.
choices.zh: 这种差异塑造了一个人在社会中的角色。

choices.text: They appear at an early age.
choices.zh: 这种差异在很小的年龄就会出现。
